objective_value: <float> Worst-case expected total operational cost represented by the complete submitted witness.
model_variables: <dict, key: canonical variable name> Sparse complete DRO witness; omitted variables are zero. Use Gurobi bracket syntax and the exact case-sensitive families in model_variable_name_patterns.
cost_structure: <str> Authoritative instance cost structure; this benchmark uses the first declared structure, Cost1.
c_w: <float> Waiting-time unit cost copied from the authoritative cost structure.
c_g: <float> Provider-idle unit cost copied from the authoritative cost structure.
c_o: <float> Overtime unit cost copied from the authoritative cost structure.
assignment: <dict, key: '{patient_index}'> Appointment position (1 through P) to which each patient is assigned in the sequence.
schedule: <dict, key: '{position_index}'> Scheduled start time, in minutes from the beginning of the session, for each appointment position.
patient_start_times: <dict, key: '{patient_index}'> Scheduled start time, in minutes from the beginning of the session, for each patient based on their assigned position.

model_variable_name_patterns.x[p,i]: patient-position assignment, p and i are 1..P
